name: The Wayfarer's Proving: First Steps
author: Browser-RPG Team
description: A compact, hands-on tutorial adventure on the Wayfarer Proving Isle. Learn dialogue, exploration, inventory & equipment, concealed crafting & field combinations, lockpicking, riddles, companions, single & multi-enemy combat, and spellcasting before venturing into the full campaigns.

worldIntro.headline: Five Trials on a Wind-Swept Coast Before the Wider Worlds Await
worldIntro.text: Between the frostbound northern jarldoms, the smoky ledger-halls of the Threshold, and stranger corridors beyond stands the Proving Isle, a stone headland maintained by retired wardens for travelers about to step into dangerous lands. Here a single compact coast holds everything a wayfarer must master: a courtyard quartermaster who trades honest steel, an ember terrace where raw iron and herbs become hidden craft, a whispering pine grove hiding old shrines and prowling wolves, crumbled ruins sealed by locks and riddles, and a sea-cliff beacon waiting to be lit. Complete the Proving to learn every tool of the engine at your own pace, then carry those instincts into any campaign on the shelf.

pillars.label: How the World Works
pillars.detail: Explore connected map locations, speak with mentors and merchants, rest safely in camp, and manage time and supplies.

pillars.label: What You Will Master
pillars.detail: Equipping weapons, armor, and rings, forging at the crucible, combining field items, picking locks, and solving riddles.

pillars.label: Combat & Arcana
pillars.detail: Face solo beasts, frontline-and-backline raiders, and a cliffside sentinel using stances, companions, and spells.

startingJournalNotes: Arrived at the Proving Courtyard to complete Warden Halrik's five trials. Speak with Halrik first to receive your proving orders.

easy.label: Guided Walk (Easy)
easy.desc: Unlimited returns to the Proving Courtyard. Nothing is lost if you fall.

normal.label: Wayfarer Trial (Normal)
normal.desc: Standard proving balance with unlimited Courtyard returns and light supply loss on defeat.

hard.label: Iron Proving (3 Lives)
hard.desc: Three Courtyard returns before the trial ends.

extreme.label: Unforgiving (One Life)
extreme.desc: Permadeath. One fall ends the proving run.

defeatNarrative: Warden Halrik's scouts haul you back to the Proving Courtyard hearth, tend your bruises, and remind you to check your supplies before heading back out.

stalk.title: Grove Trail Stalk
stalk.subtitle: Step silently between wind gusts to approach wild game or herbs
stalk.successText: You move quietly through the bracken and gather fresh Sunleaf.
stalk.perfectText: Flawless footwork! You harvest prime Sunleaf and salvage a sealed Healing Salve.
stalk.failText: A dry twig snaps underfoot and the trail goes cold.

mortar.title: Herbal Compounding Mortar
mortar.subtitle: Grind Sunleaf and Ember Resin into restorative field salves
mortar.perfectText: A clean, luminous tonic ready for the road!

astragaloi.title: Wayfarer Bone-Cast
astragaloi.subtitle: Toss four carved travel-lots at the roadside shrine for a blessing

forge.title: Ember Terrace Anvil
forge.subtitle: Strike heated metal cleanly in rhythm with the bellows
forge.perfectText: Your hammer rings true across the terrace!

shield_clash.title: Courtyard Sparring Brace
shield_clash.subtitle: Time your guard to deflect incoming strikes without losing balance
shield_clash.perfectText: Solid stance! You turn the blow aside cleanly.

factions.name: Order of Proving Wardens
factions.description: Veteran instructors and quartermasters who keep the Proving Isle safe and guide new travelers.

factions.name: Ember Terrace Guild
factions.description: Smiths, herbalists, and lantern-wrights who teach concealed crafting and field combinations.
